auth_login_lead: Enter the admin password you chose during setup.
auth_logout_failed: Couldn't sign out: Lodestar isn't responding. Check that it's running, then try again.
auth_setup_lead: Prove you run this server, then choose the admin password.
auth_token_help: Lodestar prints it to its log when it starts, in the form {format}. Pasting the whole log line works too.
auth_token_where_docker: Docker: run this command, using your container's name if it isn't lodestar:
auth_token_where_unraid: Unraid: on the Docker tab, select the Lodestar icon, then Logs.
auth_token_where_windows: Windows: open the Lodestar service log in this folder:
auth_new_password_help: At least {min} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong password that's easy to remember.
auth_strength_weak: Strength: weak. Repeats and runs of keys are easy to guess.
auth_error_token_invalid: That doesn't look like a setup token. It has 16 letters and digits, like {format}.
auth_error_bad_token: That setup token doesn't match. Lodestar prints a new one each time it starts, so copy the newest one from the log.
auth_error_too_long: That password is too long. Use at most {max} bytes.
auth_error_mismatch: The passwords don't match. Type the same password in both fields.
auth_error_bad_password: That password is wrong. Check it and try again.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
auth_error_network: Lodestar isn't responding. Check that it's running, then try again.
auth_error_server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it keeps happening, check Lodestar's log.
auth_welcome_lead: Lodestar is ready. Start searching, or review your settings.
